piece.headline: DALAL EDGES AHEAD BY A POINT AS TRIPLE CAPTAIN LANDS
piece.standfirst: Aditya Dalal's Triple Captain on Haaland puts him top by a single point. Anuj is left staring at the gap.
piece.big_picture: Aditya Dalal is top by a single point. Anuj led for a week and Haaland's armband was fine for him. It just wasn't a Triple Captain. Prerana sits third. 14 managers backed Haaland, so the gaps came from elsewhere.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Prerana, Aditya Dharap and Sahil Phadnis all skipped Haaland for the armband. Each got 0 where Haaland gave 26. That is a 26-point swing apiece.
piece.one_to_watch: Dalal leads Anuj by 1 point. The Triple Captain is gone for Dalal, so there is no chip to lean on. Anuj could pounce on any slip.

winners.name: Aarin
winners.verdict: 3 signings in, Cherki among them. The armband went on Haaland too, and the climb to 6th was earned.

losers.name: Aary
losers.verdict: Fernandes was the armband pick and nobody else touched him. He gave 2 points, and it was the week's lowest score.

ratings.l: Tripled the right man. Took the lead and made it look easy.
